hero.tagline: The solution that simplifies your life
hero.title: All your wedding planning.
hero.body1: Planning a wedding isn't winging it. It's 1,000 decisions, 20 vendors, dozens of guests, a bit of stress, and a lot of money. You're afraid of forgetting something. You have to think about every detail. And you can quickly feel overwhelmed.
hero.body2: Kaatch centralizes everything — it's like tidying your room. Once you can see clearly, your mind eases, the celebration approaches, and you can refocus on what matters: You.

whyKaatch.body: A wedding is exactly that. The moment everyone gets together to celebrate your good catch. Now we help you catch up with all your guests, every detail, every memory — without forgetting anything.

items.q: Do my guests need to create an account?
items.a: Never. Each guest gets a unique link with their name. They go straight to their space — RSVP, schedule, photo album — no sign-up, no password.

items.q: What happens after the wedding? Is my data saved?
items.a: Your data (photos, messages, guest list) stays accessible as long as your space is active. You can download everything anytime.

items.q: Can I upgrade from free to the Wedding plan later?
items.a: Yes, anytime from your wedding's Account page. Your data and space are fully preserved. You don't start over.
Kaatch is secure. Data is encrypted and never resold or shared. You own everything you publish.
Completely. Both the couple's space and guest space are designed mobile-first. No app to download — everything works in your browser.
